searchText: `interested` means within radius . This should be better clarified. I could swear it used to be written in the specs somewhere. `interested` is context dependent Not all networks/content_types use `radius` as a metric for `interest`. Ah, it is apparently written per network: https://github.com/ethereum/portal-network-specs/blob/23dda51f0d60e700b94d6b4f14dc87e7073c38da/history/history-network.md?plain=1#L81 Yeah, but for those we do not use NH gossip in the first place. Those should use Random gossip. NH gossip where the `interested` metric is every node is random gossip Yes I'm just explaining
